text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
A few days have passed since Yukari declared her broth ban.
{0} is concerned about her, so he has come to the
Mercurius Foundation's guildhouse.
text_block_list.orig_text:
禁しゅわ宣言から数日。
{0}はユカリの様子が気になって
【メルクリウス財団】のギルドハウスにやってきていた。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Ah, this calculation is off.
It looks like the numbers here haven't been added up properly.
Let's quickly fix that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ、
ここの計算間違ってる。
この部分の数字を足してないみたいね。
こっちで訂正しときましょ。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Hm? This document finally turned up?
I asked for this type of application to be expedited.
It's full of omissions too... I'll have to get in touch with them.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん、
この書類、
やっと届いたの？
こういう申請は早くしてくれって頼んでるのに。
記入漏れも多いし……
連絡返さなきゃ。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
This month's sales report... Looking good,
but there's still room for improvement.
Let's put together a plan to cut unnecessary expenses.
text_block_list.orig_text:
今月の売り上げ報告書……
堅調だけど、
まだまだ改善点はあるわね。
無駄な経費の削減案をまとめておきましょ。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Next... Oh! Well, if it isn't {0}.
What brings you here?
text_block_list.orig_text:
次は……
っと、
あら、
{0}くんじゃない。
どうしたの？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
I don't mean to be rude, but I'm quite busy.
I don't really have time to chat.
text_block_list.orig_text:
悪いんだけど、
今忙しくてね。
あまりおしゃべりする暇もないのよ。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Hm? What's wrong?
What's with the surprised look...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん？　
どうしたの？
そんな驚いた顔して……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Heheh. Thanks.
Wait. ...Did you think I was always drunk?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ。
ありがと。
ん？　
……いつもベロベロだと思われてたのかしら？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Exactly what do you think of me...?
Well, I suppose that part of my character is all you ever see.
text_block_list.orig_text:
私をどういう目で見てるのかしら……
いや、
確かにいつもそういうところばかり見られてるけど。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
That's because I've only ever shown you my careless side.
What you see now is the real me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんには油断したところばっかり見られてるけど、
これが
本来の私なのよ？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Understand? Really?
text_block_list.orig_text:
分かってる？　
本当に？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, it's already that time.
Let's go for a dri—... Argh, ignore that!
It just slipped out of my mouth by habit... Yikes...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……って、
もうこんな時間じゃない。
そろそろ飲みに……
って違う違う！
当たり前のように口から飛び出してたわ……
恐ろしい……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
You mustn't, Yukari!
You vowed to give up barley broth!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ダメよ
ユカリ！
禁しゅわするって誓ったじゃない！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, I've got to finish off the rest of my work,
so I can't go for dinner with you!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめんね、
私はこのまま残った仕事を片付けちゃうから、
キミと一緒に食事へは行けないわ！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: The next day...
text_block_list.orig_text: 翌日──

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
I have tons of work today too.
Well, best get cracking!
text_block_list.orig_text:
今日も仕事が盛りだくさんね。
さぁ、
張り切っていくわよ～！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: And the next day...
text_block_list.orig_text: さらに翌日──

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Heheheh... You're fine, totally fine, Yukari!
You live to do work!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふ、
ふふ……
平気、
平気よユカリ！
私は仕事に生きるの！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text: One week later...
text_block_list.orig_text: そして一週間後──

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Let me see, this document is aromatic...
These numbers are thirst-quenching...
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええっと、
こっちの書類は香ばしくて……
こっちの数字は喉越しがいいわね……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Doing overtime every day gives me a massive high...!
At times like this I suddenly want to take a big swig of... heheheh...
text_block_list.orig_text:
毎日残業してると、
何だか
ハイになってくるわぁ……！
こういう時は
アレを一気飲みしたく
……
ふふふふふ……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Broth?
text_block_list.orig_text: しゅわ？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Ah! I-I'm fine!
Because I'm Yukari, and I'm a responsible lady!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ハッ！？　
だ、
大丈夫よ！
私はユカリ、
大人のお姉さんなんだから！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
No, I'm not overdoing it!
Responsible ladies show self-restraint!
text_block_list.orig_text:
むっ、
無理なんてしてないわよ！？
大人のお姉さんは
自制心も強いの！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Th-that's right. I'm locked up in my room doing work all day, so I can't!
But it's best to get out and about sometimes...
text_block_list.orig_text:
そ、
そう、
部屋にこもって仕事してるからいけないんだわ！
たまには外で体を動かせば……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Er... Oh yeah, where did that document go...?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ええっと、
確かさっきの書類に……！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Found it! Here it is!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あった、
これだわ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
You'll really come with me?
That's reassuring, but... No, thank you.
text_block_list.orig_text:
本当に{0}くんも付いてきてくれるの？
心強いけど……
いえ、
ありがとうね。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
I'd better tell you in advance.
There have been reports of a monster
on the Mercurius Foundation's distribution route.
text_block_list.orig_text:
じゃあ説明しておくけど、
【メルクリウス財団】の流通ルートに
魔物が出たっていう報告があったのよ。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
We normally have knights do this kind of work.
But instead of waiting for them to mobilize, it's faster to do it myself.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こういう仕事は本来、
騎士団とかに頼んじゃうんだけどね。
まぁでも
騎士団の動きを待つより
自分で動いちゃった方が早いから。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
What? What's that look for?
Don't you think it's a bit presumptuous to worry about me?
I am a former holy knight after all.
text_block_list.orig_text:
何？　
心配そうな顔しちゃって。
お姉さんの心配なんて生意気だぞ？
これでも一応、
元聖騎士なんだからね？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Besides, getting my body moving 
really helps me keep my mind off other things...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
それに体を動かしていれば、
余計なことを考えなくて済むしね……！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
A-ha! There it is!
That's definitely the monster!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ！　
いたわ！
きっとあの魔物よ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
That nearby... wagon?
It looks like it's just about to be attacked!
I'm not sure whether the timing is perfect, or downright terrible...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
その近くに……
荷馬車？
ちょうど襲われてるところだったみたいね！
間がいいんだか悪いんだか……！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
But it looks like the driver has already escaped.
In that case, let's go and deal with that thing!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
御者さんはもう逃げてるみたいね。
だったら
さっさと対処しちゃいましょ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
I'm counting on your support!
Here I go... Wait, what?
It's brought backup...
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんは援護をよろしく！
さぁ行くわよ……
って、
あれ？
魔物が増えて……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
...What the—?
How are there this many?!
The reports never mentioned an entourage!
text_block_list.orig_text:
……何これ。
報告より数が多いじゃない！
群れだなんて聞いてないわよ～！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: But we've already been spotted. I have no choice...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも
もう見つかっちゃってるし、
やるしかないか……！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
I can't drag {0} into this...!
As a responsible lady, I have to follow through!
text_block_list.orig_text:
{0}くんに迷惑をかけるわけにはいかないわ……！
私がフォローしなきゃ、
大人のお姉さんとして！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Hahhh!
text_block_list.orig_text: はぁっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRAAAGGGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: There are loads of them, but I can still manage!
text_block_list.orig_text:
数は多いけど、
これくらいなら問題はなさそうね！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: I'm just getting started!
text_block_list.orig_text: どんどん行くわよぉっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GGRUOOOGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
It's going well!
Nope, you're not going that way!
choice_data_list: You're one hell of a fighter...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
順調ね！
おっと
そっちには行かせないわ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
What did I tell you?
There's no need to worry about me.
text_block_list.orig_text:
言ったでしょ？
心配なんていらないって。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Hehe, have you changed your opinion of me?
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふふ、
ちょっとは見直してもらえた？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
I was right. I just need to keep moving
so that I don't think about barley broth!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うんうん、
やっぱり体を動かしてると、
麦しゅわのことを忘れられていいわ～！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GGRUOOOGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Whew. And that's the end of that.
text_block_list.orig_text:
ふぅ、
これで最後ね！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Just in case, we should check on the wagon.
It's carrying... barrels?
text_block_list.orig_text:
念のため、
襲われた荷馬車の確認をしておこうかしら。
積み荷は……
樽？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
They're all smashed up, and the contents...
Hm? That smell...
text_block_list.orig_text:
壊れて、
中身が……
ん？　
この香りって……

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
{0}くん！？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Hey... Are you okay?!
You're fine? Thank goodness...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっと……
大丈夫！？
平気？　
よかった……！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
But what should I do...?
I've caused you trouble again!
text_block_list.orig_text:
でも、
どうしよう……
また私、
キミに迷惑を……！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRUOOOGHHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Oh no... the monsters... are multiplying...?
It called for reinforcements?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あ……
魔物が……
増えて……？
仲間を呼んだの！？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: I'm so, so sorry... This is all my fault...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ごめん、
ごめんね……
私のせいで……！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
What to do? Run away? But we're surrounded, and it's not like I
can sling him over my shoulder and make a break for it... Come on!
I'm an adult, but... my mind is all over the place.
text_block_list.orig_text:
どうしよう、
逃げる？　
でも囲まれてるし、
彼を担いで逃げ切れるわけない……
どうしよう。
私、
お姉さんなのに……
頭の中、
グチャグチャで……！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
...Huh?
What's that liquid you're cupping in your hands? No,
there's no mistaking...
text_block_list.orig_text:
……えっ？
何その両手の液体……
いえ、
私が間違うわけない……

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
That smell... that color... It's barley broth!
The cargo that wagon was transporting...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
その香り……
色……
麦しゅわね！？
じゃあやっぱり、
あの荷馬車に積まれてたのは……！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
H-hold on a minute, {0}!
Why are you shoving it in my face?
Stop, I can't! You know I'm under a broth ban!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ちょっ、
ちょっと{0}くん！？
何で口に近づけてくるの？
ダメっ、
ダメよ！　
私は禁しゅわするって決めたんだから！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Oh, it smells so good... Not! You sure are persistent!
We're in the midst of battle! Can't you see we're surrounded?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
わっ、
いい香り、
じゃなかった
結構グイグイくるわねキミ！
今戦闘中よ！？　
魔物に囲まれてるのよ！？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Stop overthinking it?
Yeah, maybe I'm thinking of unnecessary things, but...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
余計なことを考えずに？
いや確かに、
余計なことばかり考えてたけど……！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Drinking it will somehow help?
My secret power...?!
I have absolutely no idea what you're talking about...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
これを飲めば何とかなる？
私の秘められた力が……！？
お姉さん、
キミが何言ってるか分からない……！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Oh! So good...!
I've been dying for a swig...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あっ、
美味しっ……！
染み渡る……っ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Ungh. Damn, I drank it!
Oh, it's been so long, it feels really strong...!
text_block_list.orig_text:
ん～っ、
もうっ、
飲んひゃったじゃない！
うあ、久々に飲んだから、
すごい、
キクぅ……！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GRRRRAAAAGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Drink summore?
Come on, stooop!
Why are ya making me drink?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
えっ、
もっと飲め？
やら、
やめへったら～！
どうひて飲ませるの～！？

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GROOOAAARGHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──グオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Hey, shaddup! Ya talk too muchhh!
text_block_list.orig_text:
うっさいわよしょこぉ！　
おひゅわりぃっ！

text_block_list.name: Monster
text_block_list.text: GGRUOOOGGHHHH!
text_block_list.orig_text: ──ギャオオオオオッ！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
I said enough!
That'sh it, yer all goin' down!
text_block_list.orig_text:
あぁもう、
いいもん！
大暴れ、
してひゃるんだから～！

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: Don't ya dare messh with me!
text_block_list.orig_text:
お姉さんを
にゃめるなよ～！

text_block_list.name: Narration
text_block_list.text:
Thus, Yukari cast away her doubts, and in a rampage
eradicated all the remaining monsters.
text_block_list.orig_text:
こうして迷いを捨てたユカリの大暴れにより、
魔物は一掃されたのであった。

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Huh?
Wh-what happened...?
text_block_list.orig_text:
あれ？
ど……
どうなったの……？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text:
Wh-why are you burned? What happened?!
You got caught up in it? In what?!
text_block_list.orig_text:
キ、
キミ、
何か
焦げてない！？　
どうしたの！？
巻き込まれた？　
何に！？

text_block_list.name: Yukari
text_block_list.text: What happened?!
text_block_list.orig_text: 何があったの～～～～～！？
